title: Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture
breadcrumb: Services > Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering > Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture
meta_description: Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Most hybrid & multicloud architecture engagements stall between the deck and the deployment. Ours are built to cross that gap: The estate as designed system — landing zones, network fabric and workload placement by economics.. What follows is the working pattern, not the brochure.

Multicloud sprawl is a cost decision nobody made. We design the estate as a system: landing zones per environment with policy-as-code guardrails, a network fabric (hub-spoke, private interconnect, egress control) that makes topology intentional, and workload placement driven by data gravity, latency, regulatory zone and unit economics — not by which team inherited which vendor relationship.

We are deliberately multi-vendor across AWS, Azure and GCP, and we write the placement policy down: a workload scoring model each team can apply, with review gates for exceptions. Sovereignty and sector constraints (data residency, regulated zones) are modeled as first-class placement inputs, so audits and architecture reviews read the same truth.

Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture delivery today concentrates in Banking & Financial Services, Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Retail & Consumer Goods, Manufacturing & Industrial. The metric is chosen with your finance lead, and the baseline is signed before any build begins.
